review.recipe: Single deep champagne goblet; faint straw nearly clear Vesper with broad thin lemon peel inside; frost and tiny flecks, no ice cubes or foam.
review.personality: Nested driving gloves and folded speech sheet's blank backside reveal quiet precision for a loved companion; tightly grouped next to vessel; partial right glove edges may trim but core glove/paper remain.
review.world: Worn dark walnut reading room, restrained burgundy, neutral near-black surround; v2 extinguished extra lamps/fireplace and restored quiet left.
